content:
Bill Payment section in YONO can be accessed via Bill Payment tile in YONO as per path given below:
Path:
YONO Pre-login:
YONO Pre-login-> Bill Pay
YONO Pre-login-> Hamburger Menu-> YONO Pay > Bharat Bill Payment System
YONO Post Log in:
YONO login-> MPIN/User Id & Password-> Landing Page-> Bill Payments
YONO login-> MPIN/User Id & Password-> Landing Page-> YONO Pay -> Bill Payments
YONO login-> MPIN/User Id & Password-> Landing Page-> Hamburger Menu -> YONO Pay-> Bill Payments
You can pay various utility bills post redirection to “SBI Unipay”
Download YONO SBI
